s: January 31, 2020 - There is a notion that frugal people do things themselves rather than buying or hiring out. I love DIY projects, but even when I’m being careful, they sometimes don’t always turn out as frugal as I had hoped. While frugal and DIY can sometimes be synonymous, they aren’t always.
